subject: Literature
subcategory: Classic Novels That Changed the World
title: The Lord of the Rings and Modern Fantasy
description: A quick, practical guide to The Lord of the Rings and Modern Fantasy.

hook.text: A linguistics professor at Oxford invented entire languages and then built a world to speak them.

buildup.text: Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings created Middle-earth with thousands of years of fictional history.

discovery.text: Published in the 1950s, the trilogy has sold over one hundred fifty million copies worldwide.

twist.text: Major publishers initially rejected the book because they thought adults would never read fantasy novels.

climax.text: Tolkien single-handedly created modern high fantasy and inspired every epic fantasy author who followed.

punchline.text: A rejected fantasy trilogy became the genre's foundation.

quiz.question: What inspired Tolkien to create Middle-earth?
options: A desire to write children's bedtime stories
He invented languages first and built a world for them
He wanted to adapt Norse mythology directly
